claims.claim: Stop EditorConfig ancestor-file lookup at the template root, preventing parent-directory EditorConfig settings from flowing into this repository.
claims.trigger: Resolving editor configuration for a file under this root
claims.exceptions: Only tooling honoring EditorConfig uses this lookup boundary; this is not a claim of build-time rejection.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Both runs mark the root marker as implementation and register no constraint for ancestor lookup.
Encoding, indentation, import and other style values do not specify suppression of parent configuration.

claims.comparison_reason: All three runs register style values or describe the marker without registering the independently effective lookup boundary.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: A parent directory supplies an EditorConfig setting omitted by the repository; tooling stops at root=true and does not inherit that setting.
